items.title: Louis Hayes interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: And I have this management team, a person that books Basil’s, James Brown and Martha Burretts, that’s my management team.

ctx.x: And I guess the a number of clubs is not what it used to be. It must be a little harder to ... how do you find work?

Well at this point I do several things. But mainly I have a group, a quintet, and we just recorded two CD’s on the label TCB, on a label out of Switzerland. And one is coming out March 14th and another one I’m not sure exactly when it’s going to be released, that one. And I have this management team, a person that books Basil’s, James Brown and Martha Burretts, that’s my management team. So I’m basically involved with my group and I’m having a wonderful time with that and it’s growing. So that’s my main concern…
